text:
lia: heads-up: prod-eu is showing a spike in fncall schema rejects after we turned on strict validation in canary. small set of keys but billing token usage jumped.

lia: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T08:12:01Z] validator warn: expected object "result" but got array; req=r-zz12; key=acct_9
route=prod-eu -> routed_to=variant-a; fallback=degen
```

samir: confirmed. validation.fail_count ~4x since strict flip at 01:00 UTC.

maya: are those rejections causing immediate fallback and double charges? @alex

alex: router currently treats validation rejects as hard-fail and re-dispatches to degenerate variant. billing counts the fallback as a full invocation (so yes, effective double charge).

jon: lightweight fix: validator returns headers `X-RW-Validate: strict` and `X-RW-Validate-Err: expected_object:got_array`. Router reads and tags telemetry `route.fallback_reason` instead of reparsing body. Minimal ship.

samir: add telemetry labels `validation.fail_type` and `routing.decision`. sample failures at 100%, success samples 0.5%.

katie: console change: surface `last_validation_error` in per-route table with a redacted sample link and a filter by `validation.fail_type`.

maya: policy: should malformed requests count toward quota? ops wants them visible; billing ops prefers not to penalize.

alex: short-term: bill but show a distinct "validation" charge line and add an appeals path. revisit after metrics.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 4780012345 - validation.fail_rate > 0.9% in prod-eu (5m). Runbook triggered.

lia: action items: jon -> header+router tag PR (48h); samir -> telemetry + dashboard card (72h); alex -> billing ledger spec (EOW); katie -> UX wireframe (sync Tue). I'll add note to runbook.

lia: thanks, tracking in the incident channel :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread about fncall schema validation -> fallback routing and billing spike; includes log, code header proposal, telemetry labels, console UX, runbook alert, and action items. Single continuous text string as required.
